description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OnlineOrder" name="Online order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReturnRequest" name="Return request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder" name="Online order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OnlineOrder" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_PhoneOrder" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnRequest" name="Return request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Return" messageRef="Message_ReturnRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OnlineOrder" name="Online order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OnlineOrder" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PhoneOrder" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Return" name="Return request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_ReturnRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Warehouse team picks items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackItems" name="Warehouse team packs items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandoverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryReached" name="Shipment reached customer's address?" default="Flow_NotReached"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_SuccessfulDelivery" name="Successful delivery"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SuccessfulDelivery" name="Order fulfillment complete"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" name="Take further action on customer feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Feedback" name="Feedback actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionReturn" name="Take further action on return"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Return" name="Return actions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineToGenerate" sourceRef="Start_OnlineOrder" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneToGenerate" sourceRef="Start_PhoneOrder" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToPick" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickToPack" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_PackItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PackItems" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandoverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToDeliveryCheck" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryReached" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached" targetRef="Event_SuccessfulDelivery">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shipmentReachedAddress = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReached" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessfulDeliveryToEnd" sourceRef="Event_SuccessfulDelivery" targetRef="End_SuccessfulDelivery"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToAction" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" targetRef="End_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToAction" sourceRef="Start_Return" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn" targetRef="End_Return"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
